description: Lightweight ML model for phishing detection trained on URL features

trainingInfo.description: Trained on dataset combining legitimate websites and known phishing URLs with balanced sampling

notes: This is a lightweight logistic regression model optimized for browser performance
Weights are calibrated to work in combination with heuristic rules
Model uses sigmoid activation: output = 1 / (1 + exp(-(weights·features + bias)))
Higher output values (closer to 1) indicate higher phishing probability
